title: Once-Weekly Semaglutide in Adults with Overweight or Obesity

key_findings.claim: Average body weight reduction of 14.9% at 68 weeks on semaglutide
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Clinically proven substantial weight loss when coupled with lifestyle intervention.

key_findings.claim: Two-thirds of lost weight was regained within 12 months after treatment cessation without an exit plan
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Weight regain is driven by set-point hormonal defense. Steer structures a doctor-led off-ramp so habits hold the weight.

key_findings.claim: Caloric starvation causes circulating leptin to drop by 40% and ghrelin to surge by 240%
key_findings.citation_location: Sumithran et al., N Engl J Med 2011;365:1597-1604
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Proves that persistent food noise is driven by neuro-endocrine signals rather than a moral willpower defect.

key_findings.claim: Indian adults exhibit higher visceral fat and earlier insulin resistance at lower BMI (TOFI phenotype)
key_findings.citation_location: Misra et al., Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology 2021
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Standard BMI is inadequate for Indians; DEXA scans and 55+ biomarkers are essential for clinical safety.
